route.displayName: GO Pay As You GO Malta

events.outcome: GO PAYG resets its inactivity clock with a top-up or chargeable event; 90 days without one enters a 275-day grace period, after which the SIM disconnects unless reactivated. Visitor eSIM can be obtained through the GO app before arrival and PAYG roaming is enabled on activation.

data.acquisitionSummary: GO explicitly offers a Malta mobile number/eSIM to visitors through the GO app, including setup before landing and activation after top-up. The app flow requires SIM registration; the current visitor page does not enumerate the exact identity-document list.

keep.action: Perform at least one chargeable event or top-up before 90 days of inactivity. An outgoing local SMS on the current PAYG Base tariff is EUR0.10 and qualifies as chargeable activity. If the line enters the 275-day grace period, GO documents free SIM reactivation at a retail outlet. Do not convert this into a guaranteed remote annual cost.

data.chinaActivation: GO markets visitor eSIM setup before arrival in Malta, but activation is completed when the user tops up/starts the service. Overseas-first long-term activation beyond the documented visitor flow is not generalized.
data.kyc: The GO app/new-eSIM flow requires SIM registration. Current visitor material does not enumerate the exact accepted identity document in-app. Separate GO registration terms explicitly allow a passport for manual registration at a GO customer contact centre; this is not treated as proof of every app-registration path.
data.payment: Visitor eSIM can be topped up online from GO's website/app. Current pages support online top-up; no special foreign-card guarantee is inferred.
data.roamingSms: PAYG international activity and roaming are enabled upon activation. China is listed in GO's Prepaid Top-up Zone 4. Delivery of specific third-party OTPs remains unverified and is not guaranteed.
data.tariffSummary: Visitor eSIM is directly supported; avoid 90 days without chargeable activity/top-up. GO then provides a 275-day grace/reactivation period before disconnection; PAYG roaming is enabled on activation and China is a listed prepaid roaming destination.
guideSteps: Use the current visitor eSIM/app path rather than assuming a local-resident-only acquisition route.
Reset the inactivity clock with a chargeable event or top-up before 90 days.
Treat China roaming availability as network capability, not as a guarantee that every OTP sender will deliver.
